flawless: The Cabal welcomes all, even the hopeless. Especially the hopeless.
Praise the Cabal! You barely laid a finger on me.
solid: Suffering is a sacrament, and you gave me some. How generous.
You bled me a little. The Patriarch will be pleased I bled for him.
close: Oh, oh! The Cabal nearly gained a martyr today. Me!
I preached to a tougher crowd than I expected. Much tougher.
